{{Quote|Do these things have any weaknesses?''"<br />"''If I knew that, I wouldn't have sent that distress call, now would I?|Skywalker and Keto, discussing the pink blobs|<ref name="The Brink" />}}
The '''pink blobs''' were possibly [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] creatures that could join together to form other objects, including various technologies, such as an [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droid]]. Each blob had six claws, along with a metal device on its back.<ref name="The Brink" />

[[File:Pink_blobs.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Serra Keto]] fighting pink blobs in the form of [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]].]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the blobs were responsible for [[Mission to the Brink of the Celestial Wake|taking down]] a [[Unidentified Jedi (Brink of the Celestial Wake)|horned green Jedi]] and a contingent of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], the [[Brink of the Celestial Wake]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Serra Keto]] managed to destroy the blobs with the assistance of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who tore a hole in the space station wall, leading to the station's explosive demise.<ref name="The Brink" />
